Role.name: Super Admin
Role.description: Full access to all system modules and actions, including security settings, role management, and user management

Role.name: Admin
Role.description: Manages operational data across all modules with full edit and delete capabilities

Role.name: Viewer
Role.description: Read-only access to reports, audit logs, journals, members, and beneficiaries

Role.name: Accountant

Role.name: Auditor
Role.description: Read-only access to reports and audit logs

Role.name: Data Entry Operator

Permission.name: VIEW_AUDIT
Permission.description: View audit logs and accounting health checks

Permission.name: RUN_AI_AUDIT
Permission.description: Trigger AI analysis of detected accounting issues

Permission.name: SYSTEM_SETTINGS
Permission.description: System settings, database restore, fiscal year closing

Permission.name: MANAGE_USERS
Permission.description: Create, update, deactivate, and delete users

Permission.name: APPLY_AI_REPAIR

Permission.name: POST_JOURNAL
Permission.description: Post, reverse, or restore journal entries and transactions

Permission.name: RECORD_INCOME
Permission.description: Record income and revenue collections that post to the General Ledger

Permission.name: RECORD_EXPENSE
Permission.description: Record expenses and disbursements that post to the General Ledger

Permission.name: UPDATE_MEMBER
Permission.description: Update member records and family links
